question: Who among the following was one of the founders of the Congress Socialist Party which was founded in 1934?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jay Prakash Narayan**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jay Prakash Narayan** was one of the founding members of the **Congress Socialist Party (CSP)**, which was established in **1934** as a faction within the Indian National Congress.
 
• The CSP aimed to promote socialism and address the economic issues faced by the Indian populace.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jatindra Nath Das**: He was an Indian revolutionary who is primarily known for his role in the struggle against British colonial rule, particularly through his hunger strike in 1929 while in prison.
 
• **Jyotiba Phule**: He was a social reformer and activist known for his work in education, women's rights, and the upliftment of the lower castes in 19th-century India. 
 
• **Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan**: Also known as the "Frontier Gandhi," he was an Indian freedom fighter and a close associate of Mahatma Gandhi. He worked for Hindu-Muslim unity and the rights of the Pashtun people
